 	"IsDistinctFromExpression <- ComparisonExpression (IsDistinctFromOp ComparisonExpression)*\n"
 	"IsDistinctFromOp <- 'IS' 'NOT'? 'DISTINCT' 'FROM'\n"
 	"# LEVEL 6\n"
 	"ComparisonExpression <- BetweenInLikeExpression (ComparisonOperator BetweenInLikeExpression)*\n"
 	"ComparisonOperator <-\n"
 	"    OperatorEqual /\n"
 	"    OperatorNotEqual /\n"
 	"    OperatorLessThan /\n"
 	"    OperatorGreaterThan /\n"
 	"    OperatorLessThanEquals /\n"

 	"# LEVEL 7\n"

+	"EscapeClause <- 'ESCAPE' Expression\n"
+	"LikeVariations <- SimilarToToken / ILikeToken / LikeToken / GlobToken / NotILikeOp / NotLikeOp / NotSimilarToOp\n"
+	"LikeToken      <- 'LIKE' / '~~'\n"
+	"ILikeToken     <- 'ILIKE' / '~~*'\n"
+	"GlobToken      <- 'GLOB' / '~~~'\n"
+	"SimilarToToken <- ('SIMILAR' 'TO') / '~'\n"
+	"NotILikeOp     <- '!~~*'\n"
